description: Rep. Dan Griffey and fellow 35th District legislators Sen. Drew MacEwen and Rep. Travis Couture will hold a town hall meeting to discuss the upcoming Belfair Bypass on November 9th at the HUB in Belfair. The long-awaited State Route 3 Freight Corridor, commonly referred to as the Belfair Bypass, will be a limited access 6-mile stretch of new highway providing an alternative travel route around Belfair.
